r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system led by the prime minister, in which seats are allocated by parties' vote shares in a single nationwide district, so there are many small parties. Governments are therefore always coalitions, and small religious or far-right parties often hold the government's fate. Politics was so unstable that five general elections were held within a few years from 2019. When the government pushed a judicial overhaul curbing the Supreme Court's powers in 2023, mass protests followed. Instead of a written constitution, a set of Basic Laws serves as the constitution.

t.why: The Palestinian question in Gaza and the West Bank and its confrontation with Iran are at the center of tension across the Middle East. The Gaza war that began with Hamas's attack in October 2023 shook Red Sea shipping and oil prices; it paused with a ceasefire in October 2025 but remains fragile. In February 2026 it attacked Iran together with the United States, after which the Strait of Hormuz was blocked. The United States' closest ally in the Middle East, it receives large-scale military aid every year, and through the 2020 Abraham Accords it established ties with the UAE, Bahrain and others. International criticism has grown as cases over its conduct of the Gaza war proceed at the International Court of Justice and the International Criminal Court.
t.rel: It has peace treaties with Egypt and Jordan and established ties with the UAE, Bahrain and others in 2020. It faces the Palestinians over Gaza and the West Bank, and Iran and Hezbollah militarily.
t.korea: The two established relations in 1962. Their free trade agreement took effect in December 2022. There is much technology cooperation with Korean companies in advanced fields such as chips, cybersecurity and medical technology, as well as defense trade. Whenever the Middle East situation worsens, the safety of Koreans there makes the news.
t.know: Israel treats most of its sewage and reuses it for farming, giving it the highest water recycling rate in the world.
etext: Its start-ups and venture investment per person are among the highest in the world. Many founders come from military intelligence units, making it strong in cybersecurity, chip design and medical technology. Many foreign tech giants have research centers there.
It sells missile defense, drones and surveillance equipment to the world. Thanks to gas fields under the Mediterranean, it exports gas to Egypt and Jordan.
As the war has dragged on, mobilizing reservists has drained the workforce, and defense spending and government debt have grown. Housing and living costs are very high.
